upstream.name: Letterpress Word List
upstream.note: The package fetch script names atebits/Words, which redirects to lorenbrichter/Words. Every normalized entry was checked against this upstream snapshot.

normalization.lineSplit: Split source on CRLF or LF.
normalization.filter: Keep only entire lines matching ^[a-z]{3,12}$. No case folding, trimming, Unicode normalization, stemming, or added entries.
normalization.serialization: One word per line using LF, including exactly one final LF.

limitations: Membership means inclusion in this exact game vocabulary, not a universal judgment of English validity.
Upstream combines US, UK, and Australian spellings and may include obscure words and inflections.
The package applies profanity filters, but this is not a comprehensive moderation guarantee.
Proper names and newer technical terms may be absent. No Ethereum-specific terms were added.
